variants.name: Iterative Binary Search (Closed Interval)
variants.strategy: Maintain left and right pointers defining a closed [left,right] interval. Repeatedly check the midpoint and discard the half that cannot contain target.
variants.tracker_code:
def trace(input_data):
    sess = TraceSession("Binary Search", input_data,
        pseudocode=[
            "Set left = 0, right = n-1",
            "While left <= right:",
            "  mid = (left+right)//2",
            "  if nums[mid] == target: return mid",
            "  elif nums[mid] < target: left = mid+1",
            "  else: right = mid-1",
            "Return -1"
        ])
    nums = input_data["nums"]
    target = input_data["target"]
    arr = sess.array("nums", nums)
    left = sess.pointer("left", on=arr, idx=0)
    right = sess.pointer("right", on=arr, idx=len(arr)-1)
    answer = -1
    with sess.step("Binary search on shelf"):
        while left.idx <= right.idx:
            mid = (left.idx + right.idx) // 2
            with sess.step(f"Check mid index {mid}"):
                arr.highlight(mid, role="current")
                if nums[mid] == target:
                    sess.note(f"Found target {target} at index {mid}")
                    answer = mid
                    break
                elif nums[mid] < target:
                    sess.note(f"nums[{mid}]={nums[mid]} < {target}, move left to {mid+1}")
                    left.move(mid + 1, reason=f"Discard left half (nums[{mid}] too small)")
                else:
                    sess.note(f"nums[{mid}]={nums[mid]} > {target}, move right to {mid-1}")
                    right.move(mid - 1, reason=f"Discard right half (nums[{mid}] too large)")
    sess.result(answer)
    trace = sess.to_trace()
    for event in trace["events"]:
        op = event.get("op")
        targets = [t.get("id", "") for t in event.get("targets", [])]
        if op == "create" and "nums" in targets:
            event["code_line"] = 2
        elif op == "move" and "left" in targets:
            event["code_line"] = 9
        elif op == "move" and "right" in targets:
            event["code_line"] = 11
        elif op == "highlight" and "current" in str(event.get("role")):
            event["code_line"] = 6
        elif event.get("role") == "answer" or "answer" in targets:
            event["code_line"] = 8 if answer != -1 else 12
        elif op == "note":
            if "move left" in event.get("reason", "").lower():
                event["code_line"] = 9
            elif "move right" in event.get("reason", "").lower():
                event["code_line"] = 11
            else:
                event["code_line"] = 6
        else:
            event["code_line"] = 5
    return trace
